items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I was inclined from usually from Donovan listening to the Claiborne Williams Band in Donovan Village.

ctx.x: Well, it might have been maybe not. I know I was in Donsonville when that storm was. I was... Maybe I might have been 1916. And I did remember we had a severe... We had a heavy snow. We were living in Donsonville. And I got to check on a year with that. What is that, 1916? Because I know right... It was shortly after that. And my father's family came, got a good job in Yarlene. And he moved us all to family. My mother and my sisters and brothers. My father was still living in Yarlene. I mean, he was here already.…
That's all right. Keep on going. Yeah.
